shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"PromptBuilderConfig|baseSystemPrompt|new ChatOrchestrator|validated by\" src/orchestration specs | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,90p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,130p' src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts
rg -n \"new PromptBuilder\\(\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -12

ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | sed -n '65,175p'"

rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -40
find scripts -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*reanchor*' -o -name '*spec-link*'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/.+#|VALIDATED_BY|validated by\" AGENTS.md .lore specs src | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "docs: specify beforeSession failure lifecycle" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
